verdict.rationale: Nitrokey documents how fixes reach devices: there is a dedicated Nitrokey 3 firmware-update guide, tagged and installable open-source firmware releases (v1.8.3), and the nitropy CLI. Field updatability is also a listed product feature. Nothing in the pack covers a security-advisory channel or a lookup of which models or firmware versions are affected, so only the update-delivery part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: published security advisories, affected-model/version lookup, a documented vulnerability-response process, and independent corroboration of update handling.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the vendor has a clear firmware update and vulnerability-response story — advisories, affected-model lookup, and how fixes reach devices

citations.quote: Nitrokey 3 firmware is open source in Rust WITH tagged, installable releases
